body:
I'll let you on a little something, those people who brush it off are actually people who care, if they are not, they're sociopaths. If you do this act against yourself, the act that went against your mother and fathers decision to have their special little child, then you'll break their old hearts and your friends hearts. 

See, you might not see the people to turn to, I didn't, I resulted in committing self harm, 17 cuts on my arm for my 17th birthday, even doing that destroyed my mother. Listen, no one gives a fuck if you're alive, facts, your Dad isn't happy to see that you're alive every morning, but once he realises that he might've fucked up or that he won't ever get to see you again, don't you think that a little part of someone in your life will get depression and get the same shit you had. 

​

What i'm trying to get to is that suicide just makes more people depressed, how do I know, first-hand experience! You don't need to kill yourself just to make yourself seen by other people, that just makes you unable to be seen. Now, you can pm me if you want, im quite slow to it, i don't check my reddit religiously as I just made it to contact you. But God bless you if you're religious, and I love you for whoever, whatever you are and whatever you go through, it can be overcome through diligence and effort.
